data.title: AI boom: Is this a stock picker’s market or a buy-and-hold trade?
data.description: Morning Brief Host Jake Conley welcomes Zacks Investment Management chief market strategist Brian Mulberry to discuss how the AI boom is driving the US economy. Following an Oxford Economics report estimating that AI accounts for one-third of US economic growth, Conley asks whether investors should selectively pick AI stocks or take a broader buy-and-hold approach.
data.keywords: Jake Conley, Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist
